description: This file defines a Blits component named 'CartView' used for rendering a shopping cart interface in a furniture shopping app. It includes state initialization, a template for layout and UI, watchers for reactive updates, subscriptions to a store for cart data, and methods for handling user interactions such as incrementing, decrementing, removing items, and proceeding to checkout.

methods.name: onInc
methods.description: Increments the quantity of the current cart item by 1.

methods.name: onDec
methods.description: Decrements the quantity of the current cart item by 1, with a minimum of 1.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes the current cart item from the cart.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Initiates the checkout process if the cart is not empty.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Updates row-specific projection variables for rendering each cart item row.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes component state from the store and sets up watchers.
